name: OKins Electronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Okins Electronics Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells semiconductor inspection sockets. It offers interconnection solutions for electrical testing of IC devices, including burn-in sockets, test sockets, memory module test sockets, SSD module sockets, spring probes/pins, and PION contacts. The company also provides semiconductor test services that comprises test development, wafer probing, and package testing for analog, mixed signal, LED, MEMS, and various sensor devices.
